hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in the intensive care unit in Brasília suffering from an acute bowel obstruction while serving a 27-year prison sentence. His medical condition has triggered intense political and religious reactions, with supporters gathering outside the hospital to pray, his ankle monitor being temporarily removed during treatment, and family members visiting under judicial supervision.
hotspots.affect: Combines intense medical drama, religious martyrdom narratives, and fierce partisan polarization surrounding his imprisonment.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: Judicial investigations into confidential interior ministry leaks provided to Rassemblement National figures have escalated, leading Prefect Hugues Moutouh to request release from his duties. Political opponents have seized on the scandal to accuse the party of compromising state integrity, while RN leadership faces intense scrutiny amidst early 2027 presidential positioning.
hotspots.affect: Commands high affective investment driven by institutional scandal allegations, state security leaks, and polarized partisan combat.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox party leader Santiago Abascal and key surrogates have intensified their electoral push, explicitly campaigning on 'remigration' proposals and calling the ruling government a 'criminal mafia.' The party's aggressive campaign messaging has drawn sharp condemnation from political opponents who accuse Vox of stirring up xenophobic sentiment.
hotspots.affect: Heavily charged by explicit anti-immigrant rhetoric, aggressive culture-war posturing, and high-intensity campaign hostility.

hotspots.title: Milei Triumphs as Tesla Launches in Argentina
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei headlined the official arrival of Tesla in Argentina, showcasing the launch as concrete proof of his deregulation agenda's success. Appearing alongside a Cybertruck and addressing Elon Musk as a visionary genius, Milei used the stage to attack past interventionist economic policies.
hotspots.affect: Generates high affective charge through triumphalist free-market rhetoric, ideological validation from global tech icons, and partisan economic combat.

hotspots.title: AfD Escalates Deportation Demands at Party Congresses
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) co-leader Tino Chrupalla sparked widespread outrage by calling for the deportation of 2.6 million non-citizens, while Björn Höcke was re-elected state party chief in Thuringia declaring an intent to rule alone. The rhetoric has prompted sharp warnings from government anti-Semitism officials regarding the dangers of AfD governance.
hotspots.affect: Drives high emotional charge through radical mass-deportation rhetoric, anti-establishment defiance, and intense counter-warning alarms from state institutions.
